LanguageData.SSC_TrainerIdentity_MasterTip: Masters always have trainer status. Actual training still requires the appropriate work settings and permission for the target.
LanguageData.SSC_TrainerIdentity_UnsetTip: Unassigned identities cannot be trainers. Choose Master or Sex Slave to make this pawn eligible.
LanguageData.SSC_TrainerIdentity_SlaveTip: Allows this sex slave to be assigned as a trainer, subject to existing work requirements and target permissions. Turning this off retains assignments as inactive and lets training already underway finish.
LanguageData.SSC_TrainerIdentity_Required: Requires trainer status: a master, or a sex slave with the trainer option enabled.
